name: Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides information and collection agency services in Japan. It offers solutions for data processing, systems integration, and software development, including integrated payment, payment acceptance, and settlement services, as well as information technology services. The company also provides cloud services; data entry works; digital and credit guarantee type payment services; payment processing system; computer system development, maintenance, operation, and quality inspection; information system planning, design, management, operation, and consulting; sales of computer-related equipment and peripherals; and worker dispatch …
